title: Heroes
summary: Pick one hero per run. They share the same HP; only the skill differs.

sections.note: The Arcade replay uses the same four heroes and skills.
rows: Guillotine swings her sword and clears any surrounding obstacles that can be destroyed.
Volume drinks the potion and recovers some HP.
Vesti launches fireballs and clears any obstacles that can be destroyed.

rows.sub: Playable from day 7 of the event

rows: Maiden freezes time for 3 sec and stops any moving obstacles.

rows.text: Earn 10,000 points in a run after meeting the time condition
rows.sub: Playable from day 14 of the event
